name: CozyBooks
description: Track what you’re reading, remember every book you’ve finished.
full-description:
CozyBooks is a calm, simple home for your reading life. Track the book you’re on, remember everything you’ve finished, and always have a next read lined up, whether you finish a book a week or one a season.

📚 Your shelves, sorted
Move books between Reading Now, Want to Read, and Finished with a tap. Your whole library lives in one place and follows you to every device you sign in from.

🔍 Find any book
Search millions of titles by name or author, and add one to your shelves in seconds.

📖 Everything about a book
Author, publisher, publication date, page count, cover art and a full summary, plus related books, so your next read is never far away.

⭐ Rate what you read
Give every finished book a star rating, then sort your shelf by title, by the year you finished it, or by what you loved most.

🔁 Count your re-reads
Read a favourite again? Log it again. Every reading is dated and kept, so nothing gets overwritten.

📊 Watch your year add up
See the books and pages you’ve read this year, how they compare with previous years, and how your reading has grown over time.

🔔 Books that aren’t out yet
Keep a list of titles you’re still waiting on, so nothing slips past you on release day.

🌙 Light, dark, or system
Pick the look that suits the room you’re reading in.

No ads, no clutter, nothing to buy. Just your books. Start your shelves today.
